title: OpenAI wrapper public contract
summary: A native ESM Node.js wrapper around the official OpenAI SDK with HTTP and explicit WebSocket Responses transports and usage-based token pricing.
requirements: HTTP is the default Responses transport; WebSocket use is explicit.
The root entrypoint and declarations define the complete public API; internal modules are connected directly without legacy aliases or fallback shims.
Public behavior, declarations, README guidance, examples, and tests remain synchronized.
